name: openclaw-bridge
description: Configurable Codex conversations with OpenClaw over an existing local CLI or SSH connection.

interface.shortDescription: Talk to your OpenClaw agent from Codex
interface.longDescription: Ask questions, continue conversations, and consult plans through your existing local OpenClaw CLI or private SSH connection. Connection settings stay outside the plugin. Conversations start in Codex.
defaultPrompt: Ask my OpenClaw agent about this project.
Consult this plan with my OpenClaw agent.
Follow up on my OpenClaw agent’s last answer.
